Impeccable detector policy for huaxu.github.io. The visual world is 'the journal cover' (see DESIGN.md): deep navy plates, warm paper, amber used as a precise instrument, editorial serif typography. The rules below are generic SaaS/AI-template heuristics whose positive hits here are intentional, committed design decisions documented in DESIGN.md — not defects. They are waived so the baseline stays clean and genuinely new issues still surface. Real, objective defects (contrast, heading hierarchy, sub-11px functional text, broken images) are fixed in code, never silenced here.
  radial-halo is the page's own #263a6e glow behind the masthead, decided before this
  repository had a detector and documented in DESIGN.md; it predates every finding below
  and is waived by name so new halos still surface.
  repeating-stripes-gradient is the festival stall's awning: the .walk-stall body is the whole
  object (a striped awning over a dark counter and a basin), authored in round 50 as the honest
  answer to a stall that cannot photograph a real shop's front. It is one authored prop, not
  surface decoration, and the round-54 waiver removal had already missed it — the page-level
  check flagged all 19 pages from a clean worktree at HEAD. Waived by name again with the reason
  so a *new* striped surface still gets read against this note.
